integrity.evidence: Integral relative homology exact sequence, reflected path Lefschetz orientation, independent small-instance tests.
integrity.scientific_scope: Matching complexes of bouquets of n>=2 equal cycles C_m, m>=3; full graph automorphism group.

limitations: Full automorphism-group action on integral homology is proved, not an equivariant homotopy equivalence.
Quotient-homology statements are rational; integral quotient torsion is not addressed.
Finite checker corroborates but does not certify the universal proof; independent audit not performed.
Possible unindexed equivalent statements remain a literature-coverage risk.
title: Integral wreath-product homology of Dutch windmill matching complexes
